tax.text: Her campaign says she has focused on lowering taxes for working families.
tax.quote: Ashley has always believed it is YOUR money, not the government’s money. She has been laser focused on lowering taxes for working families and empowering all Iowans with opportunities.

schools.text: Hinson says expanding school choice lets families select an educational option that fits their children.
schools.quote: By expanding school choice, we will give families and their children the freedom to choose the right educational option regardless of zip code.

safety.text: She supported funding to hire law enforcement officers and says public safety starts with enforcing laws and supporting police.
safety.quote: I was proud to support funding to help hire more law enforcement officers in Postville and Dubuque, and I'll continue working to keep our neighborhoods safe

guns.text: She introduced legislation to repeal the federal firearm-transfer tax.
guns.quote: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to repeal the firearm transfer tax, and for other purposes.

abortion.text: Hinson describes herself as pro-life and says the unborn should be protected.
abortion.quote: I am pro-life and pro-family and will remain a strong and consistent voice for mothers and their children. We must protect the unborn and stand up for the sanctity of life.

cannabis.text: She voted no on House passage of the MORE Act, which would have decriminalized and descheduled cannabis.
cannabis.quote: MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

energy.text: Hinson has called for lower gas and diesel prices and supports expanding domestic refining and energy production.
energy.quote: Support additional permitting reform to allow for more refining capacity and domestic energy production

voting.text: She voted for federal photo ID requirements and supported requiring proof of citizenship for federal voter registration.
voting.quote: If you need an ID to board a plane and buy a six pack, you should need an ID to vote

tax.text: His platform proposes tax cuts for middle-class families alongside closing corporate and billionaire tax loopholes, so it combines tax reduction with increased taxes on some groups.
tax.quote: Cut taxes for the middle class and working families and close loopholes for billionaires and big corporations.

wages.text: He proposes raising the minimum wage with inflation adjustments and strengthening unions and collective bargaining.
wages.quote: Raise the minimum wage and pass legislation that ties regular raises to inflation to ensure a livable wage.

housing.text: He proposes simplifying permitting so affordable housing can be built faster and restricting private equity purchases of homes.
housing.quote: Simplify permitting so new affordable housing can be built faster.

schools.text: He supports increasing public-school funding and ending school vouchers.
schools.quote: Increase funding to public schools so every child has access to a world-class education.

immigration.text: He supports both an earned path to citizenship and border enforcement including deporting people who commit crimes.
immigration.quote: Pass bipartisan immigration legislation that strengthens our borders and simplifies an earned pathway to citizenship.

guns.text: His campaign-approved ad cites gun-rights protections among his legislative record.
guns.quote: Bipartisan bills to lower costs. Tax cuts. Gun rights protections.

abortion.text: He sponsored legislation to repeal Iowa’s near-total abortion ban and supports restoring Roe v. Wade protections.
abortion.quote: Make Roe v. Wade the law of the land again and protect access to contraception and IVF.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He said that biological males should not compete against females in sports.
gender.quote: As someone that spent a lot of my life in high-level sports, I don’t believe that biological males should compete against females in sports.

health.text: He proposes a public option and supports expanding Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: Introduce a public option so every Iowan has access to health care.

voting.text: He introduced a bill to make Election Day a legal public holiday.
voting.quote: House File 407, by Turek, a bill for an act making election day a legal public holiday.

sentencing.text: He partnered with a nonprofit to create community service and rehabilitation programs for nonviolent offenders.
sentencing.quote: He also partnered with a nonprofit association to create a community service program and to aid nonviolent offenders with their rehabilitation and reintegration into the community.

immigration.text: He supports a secure border and humane policies, while also proposing to raise or eliminate caps on legal immigration.
immigration.quote: I will fight for a secure border. I will also fight to raise or to eliminate artificial caps on the number of people who can legally immigrate to remove the pressure on our nation’s borders.

abortion.text: He says Congress should leave abortion policy to the states and that he would ban abortion if deciding at the state level.
abortion.quote: If it were his call at the state level? “I would ban all abortion,” Laehn said.

cannabis.text: He says he would introduce a bill to decriminalize possession and use of marijuana.
cannabis.quote: The very first bill I will introduce upon being elected to the U.S. Senate will be to decriminalize the possession and use of marijuana.
